title: Look and feel
blurb: Themes, a theme editor, glyphs, borders, titles and a screen saver.

greet: Let us make tuios look like yours. Colours first.
Hi. Themes, an editor, glyphs and borders. Pick what you like.
finish: It looks like yours now. One line shares it with a friend.

steps.title: Try on a theme
steps.note: Type to filter, arrows to browse. Watch top change colour.
steps.hint: ctrl+p, type theme, enter. In the picker type nord, or browse with the arrows. Enter keeps it.

steps.title: Open the theme editor
steps.note: ctrl+f shows only the dark themes. ctrl+e edits the theme under the cursor.
steps.hint: Open the theme picker again. ctrl+f, then type nord. ctrl+e opens the editor.

steps.title: Change the accent colour
steps.note: Enter opens the colour picker. The arrows move the colour. Enter keeps it.
steps.hint: The cursor is on Accent. Press enter, then the arrow keys, then enter again.

steps.title: Drop the change
steps.note: On your machine, ctrl+s saves it as your own theme. Here, esc twice drops it.
steps.hint: Press esc. The dock asks first. Press esc again.

steps.title: Pick heavy glyphs
steps.note: ctrl+b , opens the settings. / searches them. Glyphs are the shapes of frames and marks.
steps.hint: ctrl+b, then the comma key. Press / and type glyph. Enter opens the glyph picker. Type heavy and press enter.

steps.title: Draw borders with them
steps.note: Set Border style to glyphs and the frames turn heavy.
steps.hint: Esc clears the search. Press / and type border style. Left picks glyphs.

steps.title: Change the title style
steps.note: A title is a pill, a tab or plain text on the border.
steps.hint: Esc clears the search. Press / and type title style. Right picks the next style.

steps.title: Mark the rail's current row
steps.note: The rail is open on the right. Current row sets how it marks where you are.
steps.hint: Press / and type current row. Right picks the next style. Esc twice closes the page.

steps.title: Start the screen saver
steps.note: It kicks in by itself when you step away. Give it a few seconds, then any key wakes it.
steps.hint: Press shift+s. Enjoy it, then press any key.

steps.title: Keep it forever
steps.note: Your picks, saved in one file.
steps.hint: Press i to type, then cat .config/tuios/config.toml and enter.

steps.title: Share your theme
steps.note: One line holds the whole theme. Paste it in a chat.
steps.hint: Type tuios theme share nord and press enter.
